name: Nova
// why: This file is what makes the 'Open in GitHub Codespaces' button work.
GitHub builds this container in the cloud, installs Nova, and starts it.
Nothing is installed on the visitor's computer.
Two settings are forced for the cloud:
AI_OFFLINE_MOCK=1  so Nova runs instantly with no API key
ACTIONS_ENABLED=false because actions would affect the cloud
container, not the visitor's own machine.
Add your OpenRouter key to .env and flip the mock flag for real replies.
postCreateCommand: pip install --user -r requirements.txt && python tools/make_icons.py || true && cp -n .env.example .env && sed -i 's/^AI_OFFLINE_MOCK=0/AI_OFFLINE_MOCK=1/' .env && sed -i 's/^ACTIONS_ENABLED=true/ACTIONS_ENABLED=false/' .env
